name: Greek Yogurt with Honey-Raspberry Swirl & Pistachios
instructions: Wash and dry raspberries. Place in a medium bowl along with honey and cinnamon. Using a fork or potato masher, gently crush the raspberries until they reach a chunky, jam-like consistency. Set aside.
To serve, divide yogurt between bowls. Top with crushed raspberries, then swirl with the yogurt using a spoon. Sprinkle with pistachios and enjoy!
author: Mealime
